Pure helper that adds two uints and requires no overflow (c >= a).
Pure helper that requires b <= a before subtracting, preventing underflow.

Pure helper that requires b > 0 before dividing.

Function that lets the pending newOwner claim ownership and emits OwnershipTransferred.

Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances of address(0).
Constant function returning the balance of tokenOwner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' by debiting balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
Constant function returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract address.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, refusing ETH.
Owner-only rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract for owner.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership, authorization and balance accounting.
External call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an arbitrary address inside approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a caller-supplied token address inside transferAnyERC20Token.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply without SafeMath.
Balance updates balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...) and balances[to] = safeAdd(...) inside transfer.
Multiple balance/allowance subtractions and one addition inside transferFrom, including allowed[from][msg.sender].
